stem:
Sneha pours water into two glass tumblers that are the same shape and size. Tumbler P has water up to a higher mark than tumbler Q. Volume means the space the water occupies, not only each tumbler's full capacity.

Which conclusion about volume is correct?

options.text: Tumbler P contains a larger volume of water because the water occupies more space.
Both tumblers contain equal volumes of water because they have the same capacity.
Tumbler P and tumbler Q must hold equal volumes whenever their shapes match.
Tumbler Q holds more water than P because more empty space remains above its lower water mark.

teacher.key_rationale: Volume is the space the water occupies. Higher mark in the same tumbler shape means more volume in P.
